name: Abundance conjecture
question: Is nef K_X+Delta semiample for projective klt pairs under the usual hypotheses?
first_attack: Audit precise statement and prove a restricted case
dispatch_next: Check the main theorem and dependencies against the canonical klt characteristic-zero formulation, particularly section production and actual basepoint-freeness.
dispatch_why: A manuscript may already settle this entry. The next step is the review's own check, not a new lemma.

claim_review_2026.claimed_theorem: For projective log-canonical pairs with effective rational boundary over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, a nef Q-Cartier K_X+B is semiample, in every dimension.
claim_review_2026.scope_note: Would imply the registered projective klt rational-boundary conjecture in characteristic zero. Do not substitute the October 3 numerical-semiampleness claim, which only yields numerical equivalence to a semiample divisor.
claim_review_2026.known_caveats: Unrefereed and depends on sophisticated Iitaka/vanishing inputs; exact coefficient, characteristic and linear-versus-numerical semiampleness hypotheses need verification.
claim_review_2026.next_review: Check the main theorem and dependencies against the canonical klt characteristic-zero formulation, particularly section production and actual basepoint-freeness.
